Highlighting:
The current & future medication is not highlighted (mentioned, but not highlighted). i.e. the reader can't know if this medication will continue for the next days or not. 
Suggested example: 
Following the results of the lumbar culture, Ms Garcia immediately received an intravenous dose of benzylpenicillin, which will continue at a dose of 1.8g, on a four-hourly basis, for five days. In addition, intravenous dexamthazone, which had been commenced before the results of the culture, will be administered every 6 hours at a dose of 10mg for another four days.
